services.description: Professional full house deep cleaning service for furnished homes. Covers kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms, living room, balcony, furniture exteriors, windows, fans, switches, doors and complete floor cleaning using professional equipment and eco-friendly chemicals.

Bathroom WC, basin, mirrors & shower deep scrub
Windows, doors, switch boards & fan blades
Balcony floor wet mopping & railing wipe
Cobweb removal and complete floor sanitization

plans.name: Exclusive
plans.description: Premium deep cleaning package with shampooing services included.
